name: ai-fighter-creator
description: Create and revise AI Fighter characters locally with preserved versions, grouped previews and resumable jobs.

interface.longDescription: Create, revise and resume an AI Fighter through conversational reviews of appearance and animation groups. Preserve selected versions, inspect unfinished jobs, validate the final package and register it when requested. Runs locally on Windows x64 with Node.js 22.12+; Python 3.11+ and the bundled sprite-gen setup are required for generation. Each creator uses their own supported generation accounts. Provider access and usage charges are separate. This plugin does not include a paid generation account, guarantee animation quality or automatically approve artwork.
defaultPrompt: Help me create my own AI Fighter.
Resume my fighter and show what still needs review.

publication.release_notes: 0.3.0: Give a fighter a concept, names for its four standard moves and duel stats (power, toughness, speed; 1-5 each, total 9) that change its AI duels. Update a registered fighter in place with its fighter ID; it keeps its ID and record.
